tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate an IBAN with the exact mod-97 checksum and country format rules. Returns validity, country, and bank code. Never guess IBAN validity: use this tool.

tools.name: calculate_vat
tools.description: Add VAT to a net amount or extract VAT from a gross amount at any rate (e.g. 21 for Dutch BTW). Returns exact net, VAT, and gross amounts rounded to cents.

tools.name: check_vat_number_format
tools.description: Check the format of an EU/GB/CH VAT number (syntax only, no VIES registration lookup). Supported country prefixes: AT, BE, BG, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EL, ES, FI, FR, HR, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, LV, MT, NL, PL, PT, RO, SE, SI, SK, GB, CH.

tools.name: dutch_public_holidays
tools.description: Exact Dutch public holidays for a year, including movable feasts (Easter, Ascension, Whitsun) and King's Day rules. Use this instead of computing Dutch holidays yourself.

tools.name: working_days_between
tools.description: Count working days (Mon-Fri) between two dates inclusive, optionally excluding Dutch public holidays. Exact date math for SLA, payroll, and planning questions.

tools.name: parse_cron
tools.description: Parse a cron expression into a human-readable description and the next scheduled run times. Exact cron semantics: use this instead of interpreting cron syntax yourself.

tools.name: test_regex
tools.description: Run a JavaScript regular expression against a test string using a real regex engine. Returns all matches with capture groups and indices.

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 to text, byte-exact.

tools.name: url_encode
tools.description: URL-encode or decode a string with exact percent-encoding.

tools.name: format_json
tools.description: Validate and pretty-print JSON with a real parser. Returns formatted JSON or the exact parse error.

tools.name: csv_to_json
tools.description: Parse CSV data into JSON with delimiter auto-detection and quoted-field handling.

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Compute an exact line-based diff between two texts with add/remove/unchanged stats.

tools.name: generate_slug
tools.description: Convert text into a URL-safe slug, handling unicode and diacritics deterministically.

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Validate email address syntax and detect common domain typos (e.g. gmial.com).

tools.name: count_words
tools.description: Exact word, character, sentence, and paragraph counts plus reading time for a text.

tools.name: password_strength
tools.description: Analyze password strength with entropy-based scoring and concrete feedback. Do not log or store the password.

tools.name: generate_uuids
tools.description: Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 values.

tools.name: convert_color
tools.description: Convert a CSS color between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSB with exact math.

tools.name: markdown_to_html
tools.description: Convert Markdown to HTML deterministically.

tools.name: generate_test_bsn
tools.description: Generate Dutch BSN test numbers that pass the elfproef (11-check) but belong to no real person. For development and test data only.

tools.name: generate_test_iban
tools.description: Generate structurally valid test IBANs (correct mod-97 check digits) for NL, DE, BE, FR, or GB that belong to no real bank account. For development and test data only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: html_to_pdf, url_to_pdf, url_screenshot, qr_code_png, pdf_merge · Private data: password_strength, html_to_pdf, url_to_pdf, url_screenshot, qr_code_png, pdf_merge · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: validate_iban, check_vat_number_format, parse_cron, test_regex, format_json, text_diff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: html_to_pdf, url_to_pdf, url_screenshot, qr_code_png, pdf_merge · Private data: password_strength, html_to_pdf, url_to_pdf, url_screenshot, qr_code_png, pdf_merge · Public sink: validate_email · Destructive: validate_iban, check_vat_number_format, parse_cron, test_regex, format_json, text_diff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
